subject: INCIDENT: checkout latency above SLO for 12 min
body: Latency p99 2.4s vs SLO 800ms since 09:41 UTC. Payment provider degraded. 3 customer escalations opened. Root cause unknown. Auto-scaling did not trigger.

subject: pager fired, I am in class until 17:00
body: The checkout alert woke me. I can look after 17:00 but the SLO is burning. Someone needs to run the rollback runbook or fail over to the backup gateway.

subject: Degraded: payment-api us-east
body: Incident CLOUD-8841. Partial outage of payment-api in us-east since 09:40 UTC. Affected: checkout, refunds. ETA unknown. Recommended action: route traffic to backup gateway gw-2.

subject: double charged, need refund NOW
body: I was charged twice for one order at 09:45. Order #88231. Bank says the second charge is pending. I want it reversed today or I dispute it.

subject: Vuln scan: TLS cert for gw-2 expires in 3 days
body: Automated scan found the TLS certificate on backup gateway gw-2 expires 2026-08-18 00:00 UTC. Rotation runbook R-12 must run before expiry or checkout failover will break.

subject: refund batch needs approval by 14:00
body: Batch RB-77 has 214 refunds totaling 3,180 USD. Policy: batches over 1,000 USD require manager approval before the 14:00 bank run. Approver list attached.

subject: auto-scale event logged, action recommended
body: Scaling policy did not fire because the metric tag changed. Suggested: run rollback runbook RB-9 against payment-api and verify gw-2 reachability.

subject: wholesale client threatens to leave after outage
body: Acme Retail says the 12 min checkout outage cost them sales. They want a written RCA by tomorrow or they move to the competitor. This is a churn-risk account (ACV 90k).

subject: gw-2 health probe: reachable, cert risk only
body: Failover gateway gw-2 answers probes. Only the cert is at risk. RB-12 rotation needs one approved change ticket. Propose the change with evidence from this probe.
